title: Festival/weird camp
content: Since I’m convinced by the hypothesis that we go to a shared astral space when we sleep, did anyone go to a Food and Wine festival last night? It was super crowded. Glass plates. Items like macaroni and cheese and pizza sandwiches? Outdoor venue like a park? Or has anyone been to a strange camp that almost seemed like an intellectual Bootcamp? I was there last night too with about 300 others (maybe more). There were five or six houses, and then a large outdoor common area. We played a trivia game that involved cards and buzzers in small groups outside. The rules were pretty strict but the game was difficult. Just curious if these settings sound familiar to anyone.
